recipe.visualDefinition: A central mythological bird emblem rising from a fiery landscape into a starry cosmic void. The style features smooth airbrushed gradients, sharp graphic outlines, and a warm-to-cool vertical color transition.
coreVisualRelationships: Central phoenix emblem framed by a circular geometric border
Vertical progression from terrestrial fire to celestial space
Contrast between organic flame shapes and rigid circular geometry
Symmetrical balance of the bird wings against an asymmetrical starfield
coreInvariants: Lightning bolts behind the central figure

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central phoenix figure occupying the middle third of the frame, enclosed in a circular medallion.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The phoenix's head and the flame it breathes, positioned at the center of the circular frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Upward trajectory from the bottom flames, through the bird's body, following the lightning bolts toward the top text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep space black at the top corners provides breathing room for the display typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep cosmic black and dark purple in the upper half.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange and yellow for the fire and lower horizon.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta and pink for the bird's wings; cyan for the lightning.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central emblem against a desaturated, grainy background gradient.
paletteRestrictions: High-contrast white for stars and highlights

letterConstructionRules: Main title features a fluid, brush-like script with varying line weights and a slight drop shadow.
Secondary text follows the curve of the circular frame in a geometric, futuristic sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Curved baseline for secondary metadata text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Fluid organic script contrasted against rigid geometric path-following sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s/80s rock aesthetic of the main title.
Matches the geometric, tech-influenced secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an airbrushed cosmic landscape. The bottom features stylized orange flames and yellow pyramids. The middle features a circular medallion containing a pink and purple phoenix with lightning bolts in the background. The top is a dark starry sky with a grainy texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a white brush-script title at the top center with a subtle drop shadow. Add geometric sans-serif text following the upper curve of the central medallion's border.

verificationChecks: Is the phoenix centered within the circle?
Does the color transition smoothly from fire-orange to space-black?
Is the grain texture consistent across the airbrushed areas?

adjustableVariables: Number of pyramids at the horizon
mustRedesign: Specific band name and album title text
Specific logo marks on the bird's chest
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the dark background
Check that the phoenix wings are symmetrical
Verify the circular border is perfectly round
Confirm the fire at the bottom has a painterly, non-photorealistic feel
recipe.reuseFormula: Central mythological icon + circular framing + vertical elemental transition (fire to space) + airbrush texture + brush script typography.
